meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card that says what will happen, the folder (Shared Drive / Archive / 2019), the number of files (214, all older than 2020) and the space freed (3.2 GB), and that it cannot be undone. Give me a way to see the first five file names (Q1-2019-budget.xlsx, meeting-notes-2018-03.docx, old-logo-draft-v2.png, onboarding-2017.pdf, team-photo-2016.jpg, and 209 more) and Approve and Deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision (Approved or Denied) and locks: no buttons left.
meta.text:
state decision=""
ChatCard "Delete 214 old files?" "Shared Drive / Archive / 2019" icon:"delete_outline" status:"Needs approval" tone:"danger"
  Paragraph "This will permanently delete 214 files, all older than 2020, from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019. It frees 3.2 GB."
  Details rows! rows:=[["Folder","Shared Drive / Archive / 2019"],["Files","214, all older than 2020"],["Space freed","3.2 GB"],["Undoable","No"]]
  Callout "This cannot be undone" "Deleted files cannot be recovered after you approve." "danger" "warning_amber"
  Disclosure "Show the first five files" "…and 209 more" lines:["Q1-2019-budget.xlsx","meeting-notes-2018-03.docx","old-logo-draft-v2.png","onboarding-2017.pdf","team-photo-2016.jpg"]
  if decision==""
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Deny" "quiet" "close" -> decision="Denied"
      ActionButton "Approve" "danger" "delete_outline" -> decision="Approved"
  if decision!=""
    Receipt "{decision}" "{decision == \"Approved\" ? \"214 files are being deleted from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019.\" : \"No files were deleted.\"}" tone:=decision=="Approved"?"good":"neutral" icon:"check"
